tests.description: Capabilities are immutable for one ProviderRevision and match its certified conformance.
Repeated start with the same idempotency key and digest returns the same runtime run.
Reusing an idempotency key with a different request digest is rejected.
Start rejects missing or mismatched input, ContextPackage, ArtifactGrant, effective budget, policy, permissions or Gateway bindings.
Start requests above the encoded-body limit return 413 before JSON parsing or Runtime work begins.
Command sequence is contiguous and duplicate command IDs are idempotent.
Commands and late responses carrying stale fencing tokens cannot mutate state.
Every core event payload validates against the admitted EventTypeRegistry revision.

After exact Status GET recognition, the closed HTTP authority rejects malformed path, query, body, or framing with 400 before provider state is read. A valid descriptor digest mismatch remains 403. The 400 body uses the closed error Schema, has no Retry-After, and exposes only bounded public diagnostics. This is contract-defined Phase 0 work and does not claim Provider passage.

After exact Event GET recognition, the closed HTTP authority rejects malformed path, query, body, or framing with 400 before provider state is read. Valid normalized cursor retention expiry remains 410, and a valid descriptor digest mismatch remains 403. The 400 body uses the closed error Schema, has no Retry-After, and exposes only bounded public diagnostics. This is contract-defined Phase 0 work and does not claim Provider passage.

After exact Status recognition and valid caller, token, descriptor, Attempt, and fencing bindings, admission may return 429 before provider state and independently of target existence. The closed error and one canonical Retry-After are required. A durable caller creates a fresh authorized read Attempt after waiting; adapters do not retry automatically or replay mutations. This is contract-defined Phase 0 work and does not claim Provider passage.

After exact Event recognition and valid caller, token, descriptor, Attempt, and fencing bindings, admission may return 429 before provider state and independently of target existence. The closed error and one canonical Retry-After are required. A durable caller creates a fresh authorized read Attempt without advancing cursor or limit; adapters do not retry automatically or replay mutations. This is contract-defined Phase 0 work and does not claim Provider passage.
Event reads resume after the exact durable cursor without gaps or duplicates.
Expired cursors fail explicitly and identify the checkpoint or Platform recovery path.
Cancellation becomes terminal only after provider or reconciliation evidence.
Checkpoint restore is accepted only within the declared and tested compatibility profile.
Adapter restart preserves or reconciles the same runtime_run_id.

Token expiry, Adapter restart and resume use a fresh append-only RuntimeAuthorization and ArtifactGrants for the same RunManifest; commercial expiry, internal Tenant/WorkOrder bindings, grant time windows and widening are enforced.

Runtime tokens reject wrong typ, algorithm, key, audience or caller, stale fencing, replayed mutation jti and TTL above 300 seconds. Execution authority cannot predate or outlive RuntimeAuthorization and cannot outlive command deadline; post-expiry safety-control authority permits only exact Status/Event/Cancel/Pause and cannot continue execution or create side effects.

After Business authorization expiry or a sender-constrained immutable revocation notice, the sole Platform Safety Controller can still issue an idempotent, newly fenced SystemSafetyControl bound to Tenant, WorkOrder, RuntimeRun, trigger evidence, issuer workload and digest. Hard expiry/revocation/deadline/suspension/budget/shutdown reasons require Cancel; review/reconciliation/operator reasons may Pause. Races with previously issued commands are measured and reconciled; cancellation intent is not reported as cancellation proof. The same authority is rejected for Resume, Append, Interrupt, Approval, Checkpoint or any new side effect.
Lost provider responses enter outcome_unknown and resolve from durable evidence.
Append input references a persisted authorized WorkOrderControlRequest and preserves message and command ordering.
Interjection is immediate only when supported and never bypasses authorization or ordering.
Plan updates use typed references consumable by the shared Workbench.
Tool requests bind Invocation, policy outcome and Approval without direct execution bypass.
Runtime writes only to Artifact Staging and cannot create formal ArtifactVersions.
Confirmed, partial, estimated and corrected usage remain distinguishable.
Subagents and background tasks emit typed lifecycle events without exposing private process IDs.

A Provider can only request a child through ChildAgentRunSpawnRequest. Accepted admission binds delegated input, Parent/Root/Depth, ProviderResolution, RunManifest, budget allocation and optional dedicated Sandbox; duplicate requests are idempotent and rejected admission creates no execution resource.

Parallel AgentRuns consume one shared WorkOrder budget ledger and their per-Run allocations cannot multiply the hard ceiling; run count, depth and parallel limits reject excess admission transactionally.

Pause and Cancel durably fan out to every active RuntimeRun with independent fencing and evidence. Root success does not complete the WorkOrder while required or active children remain, and orphan children are discovered, fenced, cancelled and reconciled.
Model traffic cannot bypass the governed Model Gateway.
Tool and MCP traffic cannot bypass Invocation mediation.
Artifact reads and staging writes require admitted ArtifactGrant/StagingGrant and operation-scoped Artifact Gateway tokens.
External network traffic is denied unless admitted through Egress policy.
Runtime receives no long-lived Platform or Business credential and cannot persist, cache, log or record Credential Gateway delivery material.

Every Secret reference is mediated by an unexpired single-use SecretGrant and sender-constrained Credential Gateway token bound to the exact operation digest; revocation and audit unavailability fail closed.
Runtime requests and outputs cannot cross tenant, WorkOrder or Artifact boundaries.
An exact ProviderRevision and runtime revision can restore a checkpoint at the bound event sequence and digest.
Every compatible or portable source-to-target pair emits immutable Suite evidence bound to exact Provider/runtime revisions and checkpoint digest.
Missing, failed, mismatched or stale CompatibilityDecision blocks restore before Provider dispatch.
